documents.text: Granola supports shared meeting notes and exports, with vendor documentation for workspace collaboration.
Fathom supports Zoom, Microsoft Teams, and Google Meet recording workflows.
tl;dv documents EU hosting options and a 30 day recording retention policy for this evaluated plan.
Fireflies provides CRM integrations including HubSpot and Salesforce synchronization.
A generic meeting assistant with no verified residency, retention, or CRM evidence.
